objective: Identify the most specific public electricity queue, interconnection, connection, service, regulatory or planning record for every Epoch AI frontier/data-center site.
important_rule: A jurisdiction-level queue is not a site-specific queue match. Site-specific queue IDs are only recorded when the site identity is defensible.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: ERCOT Large Load Integration / Batch Zero
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.use: Large-load interconnection requests and study process
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: ERCOT market jurisdiction; local transmission/distribution utility records may still be required.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: PJM Service Requests / Interconnection
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Applicant/site fields vary by public export.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: SPP GI Active Requests / Study Listing
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: SPP generation-interconnection materials are not automatically load records.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: SPP High Impact Large Load (HILL)
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Process materials and filings must be tied to the physical campus.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: MISO Generator Interconnection Queue
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Generator queue is not synonymous with MISO new-load announcements.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: MISO Generator Interconnection Queue page
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Use separate MISO new-load/customer records for large-load evidence.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: NYISO Interconnection Queue
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.use: Generation and Load Projects queue workbook
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Queue MW and Epoch IT MW remain different measurements.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: CAISO Interconnection / Cluster materials
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.use: Generator interconnection and related cluster documents
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: The current registry capture is Cluster 15 only; whole-queue coverage requires additional CAISO clusters/materials.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: ISO-NE IRTT External Reports
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Public table used by the registry does not publish study stage.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: IESO Connection Application Status
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Zone/location fields may be electrical zones rather than municipalities.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: AESO Connection Project Reporting
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.use: Connection project list and related reporting
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Applicant/developer fields can be unpublished.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: Bonneville Power Administration Interconnection
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Only applies to BPA-served transmission/connection contexts.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: NESO Connections 360
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Connection data are not equivalent to a North American RTO queue ID.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: NESO Connections Registers / TEC Register
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Requires project-to-campus identity matching.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: AEMO NEM Registration List
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.use: Registered market participants and scheduled loads
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Registration is not necessarily the same as a physical connection approval.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: AEMO Connection Process / Connection Scorecard
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Network Service Provider records may be required.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: Fingrid Main Grid Connection / Open Data
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.use: Main-grid connection process and public data
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Distribution-connected campuses require DSO records.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: Svenska kraftnät Connection Process / Queue
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Local network connections may be outside the transmission queue.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: Statnett Connection Process
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Local DSO connection may be the relevant record.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: Tenaga Nasional Berhad Connection / Supply
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.use: Electricity supply and large-customer connection evidence
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Public site-level queue identifiers are not consistently exposed.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: REN Grid Connection
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Distribution connections may be under E-REDES.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: E-REDES Connection
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Site-level public queue data may be limited.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: Landsnet Connection
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Local distribution records may also be required.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: PLN Grid Connection
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Public queue identifiers are not consistently exposed.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: State Grid / Provincial Grid Connection
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Public site-level queue visibility varies by province.

direct_queue_and_connection_sources.name: EWEC / Abu Dhabi power-system connection evidence
direct_queue_and_connection_sources.limitation: Site-level public queue identifiers may not be exposed.

cross_cutting_public_sources.name: FERC eLibrary
cross_cutting_public_sources.use: Transmission, utility and large-load regulatory filings
cross_cutting_public_sources.limitation: Search is docket/document based rather than a single queue table.

cross_cutting_public_sources.name: FERC RM26-4 Large Load Interconnection
cross_cutting_public_sources.limitation: Rulemaking docket is not itself a site registry.

cross_cutting_public_sources.name: GridTracker
cross_cutting_public_sources.use: Daily queue snapshots, data-center facilities and regulatory-document discovery
cross_cutting_public_sources.limitation: Secondary source; primary utility/RTO/commission record should be retained for site-level claims.

cross_cutting_public_sources.name: GridTracker MCP
cross_cutting_public_sources.use: Search across queue requests, PUC/FERC filings and data-center permits

cross_cutting_public_sources.name: Interconnection.fyi
cross_cutting_public_sources.limitation: Secondary; verify against the underlying utility/RTO/regulator.

cross_cutting_public_sources.name: Watt Street state interconnection queues
cross_cutting_public_sources.use: State-by-state queue aggregation and data-center campus index
cross_cutting_public_sources.limitation: Aggregation/discovery layer; not the authoritative queue.

cross_cutting_public_sources.name: LBNL Queued Up
cross_cutting_public_sources.use: Historical generator/storage queue coverage across ISOs/RTOs and non-ISO utilities
cross_cutting_public_sources.limitation: Generator interconnection dataset; does not include load interconnection requests.

cross_cutting_public_sources.name: Texas AI Docket
cross_cutting_public_sources.use: Facility dossiers combining queue, PUCT docket, permit and service evidence

cross_cutting_public_sources.name: SueDataCenters / Compute Atlas
cross_cutting_public_sources.use: Facility identities, locations and cited public records
cross_cutting_public_sources.limitation: Facility registry, not a utility queue.

cross_cutting_public_sources.name: GridCensus
cross_cutting_public_sources.limitation: Secondary and may place detailed queue data behind paid tiers.

cross_cutting_public_sources.name: Grid Interconnection Tracker
cross_cutting_public_sources.use: ISO/RTO queue and large-load market screening
cross_cutting_public_sources.limitation: Directional/secondary; underlying records should be verified.

supporting_public_record_families.name: State PUC/PSC docket systems
supporting_public_record_families.use: Large-load tariffs, service agreements, utility contracts, transmission approvals and site-specific proceedings
supporting_public_record_families.examples: Georgia PSC, PUCT, Michigan PSC, North Carolina Utilities Commission, Arizona Corporation Commission, Nevada PUC, Utah PSC, New Mexico PRC, Wyoming PSC

supporting_public_record_families.name: Investor-owned utility / municipal / cooperative large-load records
supporting_public_record_families.use: Service agreements, tariffs, customer contracts, connection studies, system impact studies and customer-planning records
supporting_public_record_families.examples: TNB/OG&E/OPPD/Alliant/MidAmerican/Coleman County EC/Duke/AEP/Georgia Power/TVA/NV Energy/APS/PNM and others

supporting_public_record_families.name: Local government land-use / permit records
supporting_public_record_families.use: Parcel identity, site plans, electrical service clues, generator permits, zoning and development approvals
supporting_public_record_families.examples: County/city planning portals, building permits, environmental permits, economic-development agreements

supporting_public_record_families.name: Environmental regulator records
supporting_public_record_families.use: Air permits, water permits, emergency-generator permits, environmental assessments and facility identifiers
supporting_public_record_families.examples: State/provincial environmental agencies, EPA and equivalent national agencies
